ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; high-intensity white pixels represent approximately 3-5% of the total visible surface area relative to the dominant low-intensity black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-mapped pixels dominate the central and lateral regions; high-contrast geometric clusters are localized at the distal tips and in three distinct focal points in the lower-central fluke region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with a pixel-measured internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge; notably sharp peaks and deep narrow valleys present on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric downward convex curve from the distal tips toward the central notch, following a non-linear downward parabolic path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete high-contrast circular clusters on the distal tips (left and right) and sparse, isolated high-intensity circular nodes on the mid-ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep traumatic indentation on the distal right lobe margin and dense colonization of raised biological material on the lateral lobe extremities.
